correctness.rationale: Four equiprobable Rademacher classes with antipodal symmetry and 4-by-4 doubly stochastic coupling transport prove full 3D iff classification via Birkhoff/rearrangement. Symmetric spectral-function covariance is nonnegative by a weighted-difference sum, making n=2 shared signs optimal. The explicitly diagonally dominant SPD L and increasing polynomials have four exact trace outputs, and coordinate swap achieves the unique matching rank arrangement: contrast variances exactly 62/9 and 2/9. Exact-rational checker independently verifies 780 assertions, including all 24 four-class permutations on finite test grids; proof does not depend on enumeration.

value.rationale: Provides a natural complete decision criterion for whether the standard common-random-number design is truly best at the first dimension of possible failure. An explicit cheap coordinate swap, with no change to independent-sign marginals or per-pair function actions, lowers the one-sample variance for a natural polynomial trace difference by exactly 31-fold. This is a motivated structural and numerical boundary, not an arbitrary parameter grid or marginally improved constant.
